title: Exhaust Control
description: The service behind Pop-Bang. Opens and closes the DME's exhaust valve over UDS (service 2E / 2F) through the head unit's diagnostic gateway (TASU) via hmictl. Exposes a JSON-line control socket at /run/edzco-exhaust/ctl.sock. Safe by default: refuses to write while the car is moving or the engine is off; a watchdog closes the valve after HOLD_MAX_MS of held-open. All DME write payloads live in /opt/edzco-exhaust/config.json - the operator fills them from their own research against their own engine (B48 / B58 / S55 / S58 / N55 differ). With no configured payload for the connected ECU, the tool refuses to write and tells the app so.
